task: Explore: differential fuzzing of the portfolio's three MT940 readers
errors: A first harness edit through a bash heredoc with ${} template literals failed on bash 'bad substitution'; rewrote the harness as a committed file with the Write tool.
CI changed-ventures failed on platform/ci/check_cli_entry.py: the harness's CLI guard compared import.meta.url to a hand-built file:// string; switched to pathToFileURL and pushed a fix.

doc_friction.issue: Said tests run with `node --test`; CLAUDE.md says Node 22 needs `node --test '*.test.mjs'`. Updated.

notes: Idea: use the repository's three independently written MT940 readers as each other's test oracle. ventures/eu-bank-statement-reader/mt940-differential.mjs generates valid MT940 files with known transactions (20 variations plus a mangle mode) and compares all three readers. Found three bugs in eu-bank-statement-reader, all fixed: only the first SWIFT {4:} message in a file was read (787/1000 multi-message files wrong, balance check still passing), a '}' in :86: ended the block early, and YY 70-99 read as 20xx. ai-bookkeeper and mt940-statement-check agreed on every file; no reader threw on 5,000 mangled files. Verification: run_venture_tests.py for the three ventures: 3 suites, 0 failed (60 + 30 + 3264 tests); 7 new tests fail on the old calc.mjs. check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links and check_llms_txt_links clean. Next: the same harness for the four camt.053 readers.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer writing an MT940 generator, three adapters, diagnosing and fixing the envelope bug, tests and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
